name: revenue_by_region
question: what was our revenue by region?
reference_sql: SELECT lower(c.region) AS region, SUM(oi.qty * oi.price) AS revenue
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
reading: Four regions, not eight spellings. A soft-deleted customer keeps their revenue: the money was real even though the account is gone.
